title: 12 V 50 W heater element on a base

sources.citation: The 12 V resistance heating element (vehicle and bench heaters, de-icing pads), commonly rated in watts at 12 V; 50 W is a usual rating of the class (typical published figures, paraphrased, not one vendor's). Its resistance is V² / P = 2.88 Ω. A nickel-chromium element's resistance rises only a few percent from cold to hot (a temperature coefficient of about 1e-4 per kelvin), so it is taken as constant at the rated (hot) value.
game-design: the element in a guard on a 90 × 50 mm base, 40 mm tall, with a screw terminal at each end; not modelled on a product.
